We celebrated the launch of @boka x @drinkolipop Pomegranate Sparkle at Pearl Box in NYC! The festive soirée brought together beauty, wellness, and oral care to introduce their new probiotic toothpaste inspired by the mouth-gut connection! From Pomegranate Sparkle-inspired cocktails and mocktails to on-site tooth gems, it was a fun night all about glowing from the inside out!\

🦷 Boka x OLIPOP Pomegranate Sparkle is available now at Boka.com and coming soon to Target!\
